## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*Sanidassanattika, Vipākattika* is an Abhidhamma text located within the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. As designated by its title, the text examines conditional relations at the intersection of the *sanidassanattika* (the triad concerning the visible or with-visibility) and the *vipākattika* (the triad concerning karmic results or fruition) within the framework of the Abhidhamma relational system [SuttaCentral].

No direct ancient parallels in Chinese, Tibetan, or Sanskrit are listed by SuttaCentral, and DharmaNexus finds no cross-language alignments meeting the match threshold [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis by DharmaNexus documents extensive intra-canonical textual reuse across the Abhidhamma, noting 88 matching passages shared with 37 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. These recurring formulas are found predominantly in related sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, with the most significant overlaps occurring in *Vipākattika* (Patthana 1.4, matching §2.1–3.1_1 to §36.1–37.1_1), *Sanidassanattika, Sārammaṇaduka* (Patthana 16.65), and *Sanidassanattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 17.27) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
